title: Post-Critical Meson Dynamics of Kibble-Zurek Excitations in a 5,564-Qubit Quantum Annealer
summary: Quantum phase transitions provide a controlled route for generating many-body excitations, but the dynamics after the critical point can be as important as the initial defect creation. Recent progress in quantum annealing has made it possible to access coherent nonequilibrium dynamics in programmable Ising systems with thousands of superconducting qubits. Here we use this capability to study a longitudinally biased quantum Ising chain, where Kibble--Zurek defect creation is followed by nonintegrable post-critical dynamics.
